subject.title: Exploring a chat-first Android surface for OpenClaw (discussion + possible focused upstreaming)

question: Should the official Android app adopt a chat-first default or mode, keep the current Overview-first companion-node shape while accepting focused chat/media/connectivity PRs, or move this discussion entirely to the mobile RFC process?
rationale: Current main partially addresses the requested direction but changing the default Android surface affects onboarding, pairing, gateway security posture, media permissions, and mobile product identity, which automation cannot choose.

options.title: Use RFC plus focused Android slices
options.body: Keep the source issue open or link it to the mobile RFC until Android owners pick narrow, proof-backed PR slices for chat entry, media, and connectivity.

options.title: Sponsor chat-first Android mode
options.body: Have Android owners explicitly approve a chat-first mode/default and require upgrade, onboarding, pairing, and media-permission proof before implementation merges.

options.title: Keep Overview-first and external forks
options.body: Document that the official Android app remains an Overview-first Gateway companion and ask chat-first forks to stay external unless they file specific defects or narrow PR slices.

recommendation.title: Use RFC plus focused Android slices
recommendation.body: Keep the source issue open or link it to the mobile RFC until Android owners pick narrow, proof-backed PR slices for chat entry, media, and connectivity.

likelyOwner.reason: obviyus is the listed Android app owner and authored key Android chat-routing history, making them the best first product-routing owner for this issue.
